# raff_vpc_cidr_suggestions (Data Source)

Returns a recommended CIDR (and alternatives) that does not overlap your existing VPCs. Useful for declaratively sizing a new VPC without hardcoding a block that might conflict.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `alternatives` (List of Object) Non-overlapping CIDRs sized small / medium / large. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--alternatives))
- `existing_count` (Number) Number of VPCs the account already has.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `suggested` (String) Recommended CIDR — non-overlapping, right-sized for typical use.
- `suggested_ips` (Number) Number of usable IPs in the suggested block.

<a id="nestedatt--alternatives"></a>
### Nested Schema for `alternatives`

Read-Only:

- `available_ips` (Number)
- `cidr` (String)
- `size` (String)
